methods: Read all three operator helpers and current deploy.cli, manager, HTTPS, account APIs, auth implementation, ledger export/receipt maintenance and CI result schemas.
Only the three assigned ignored helpers were edited; no production source was edited by this review.
Syntax checks and in-memory mocked evidence/process, SQLite and JavaScript VM fixtures only.

changes.problem: Post-deployment account before/after tests did not establish preservation across the application/authentication migration itself.
changes.resolution: Before control-update, fixed-path mode=ro/query_only SQLite transaction captures every accepted non-system/non-operation business row as operation ID plus SHA256, bound to source identity. Root-private create-only baseline is persisted before the first update. Final services compares every original row and the generation without invoking receipt recovery RPCs.
changes.evidence: Offline in-memory SQLite fixture checks accepted filtering, full-row equality, tolerated new rows, changed-row rejection and no baseline overwrite.

changes.problem: The deployment stage chain could declare services complete independently of account before/after acceptance and without proving matching source/release.
changes.resolution: restart requires successful before summary; verify-restart requires the identical before proof; after requires completed bound restart and verify-restart; services requires successful after and the original before summary. All use one acceptance directory, exact source binding, release, preparation SHA and acceptance script SHA.
changes.evidence: Offline source/release/script match accepted; failed, different-release and different-source summaries rejected. Static control flow confirms verify-restart before after and after before services.

changes.problem: runtime/status returns worker state, so absence of the gateway-only activityUncertain field could be treated as an idle gateway. The acceptance runner did not independently check host 120.
changes.resolution: Check fresh gateway WebSocket state for explicit false activityUncertain/maintenance/unknown and zero work, in addition to worker status; require local IPv4 192.168.1.120 before writes or connections.
changes.evidence: Offline VM accepts explicit idle state and rejects gateway uncertainty and maintenance.

changes.problem: ClientRequest close without response end/error cleared its timer and removed tracking but did not settle the promise.
changes.resolution: Premature close explicitly rejects with http_closed_before_end; successful completed response remains successful.
changes.evidence: Synthetic EventEmitter transport verifies both premature-close rejection and complete-response success without network.

changes.problem: subprocess.run timeout kills only the direct CLI; descendant pipe holders can keep final output collection blocked.
changes.resolution: Launch a new owned process session; on timeout kill that group and bound final communicate/wait. Keep dispatch outcome unknown and retain restricted diagnostics; never infer that separately started systemd units stopped.
changes.evidence: Mocked timeout verifies start_new_session, owned group signal, five-second drain and unknown result; no actual process was launched by this fixture.

changes.problem: Local-equivalent evidence could bypass the current requirement for an independently verified GitHub CI run; one platform could omit a case passed only in the other platform.
changes.resolution: Require GitHub run provenance and exact same standard case ID inventory for Linux and Windows, retaining complete three-platform source/head binding, raw/aggregate consistency and every-skip passing counterpart.
changes.evidence: Offline complete evidence accepted; local-equivalent, omitted case despite counterpart pass, post-test source drift and raw/aggregate mismatch rejected.

fixtureCorrections: Windows offline Path fixture needed an absolute synthetic drive path to exercise Linux-only URI logic.
The offline sqlite.connect stub first used uri as both a positional and keyword parameter; corrected the stub. These were fixture construction errors, not production script failures.

executionSequence: Main reviewer independently verifies the exact GitHub Actions run and all five artifacts; pin its manifest SHA.
Copy all three reviewed scripts, including the account acceptance .mjs, to the fixed root-owned BASE directory.
Run prepare with exact tested source/archive/head/evidence identities.
Run control-update (captures the pre-migration receipt baseline), app-update, account-setup, https and verify in order.
Run account acceptance before with a fresh allowed acceptance directory.
Run restart then verify-restart, each with --acceptance-directory pointing to that same directory.
Run account acceptance after; it proves the same remembered session survived both service restarts and then logs out that test session.

Run services with the same --acceptance-directory; this checks successful after evidence, all pre-migration accepted business receipts, selected running gateway/worker executables, enabled active Caddy and removal of legacy Authelia.
limitations: No claim of actual host, systemd, TLS, account migration or restart acceptance; those steps remain unexecuted.
Read-only journal inspection uses normal SQLite read transactions and may participate in ordinary WAL read locking; it issues no data mutation or recovery RPC.
Any started or stopped stage remains inspect-only. No stage retry, automatic rollback, reset, journal rotation or log cleanup was added.
No new production-source defect was established in this helper review.
The scripts assume the retained authorized synthetic instance and credentials paths; root reviewer must retain those exact inputs and perform the CI verification before execution.
